rows.title: Commodity page and Commodity details wording and selected commodities table match Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: The two commodity pages keep their frame but change their words to Design Release 2.1's: the commodity page's inset text about one notification per ITAHC, the live-animals search hint (common name, code or Latin name, with no 3-character sentence), the Trade Tariff link's '(opens in a new tab)' on its own line, Commodity details' caption 'Description of the goods', and a Species column in the Selected commodities table listing the Latin names chosen under each commodity. Every changed or added English string gets its Welsh counterpart, marked as a machine draft, so the Welsh pages do not fall behind.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page's inset text reads 'You must submit a separate notification for every single ITAHC. You must also submit a notification for goods that do not need an ITAHC.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-073; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-005; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-043)

The tests repo's commodities and consignment-details page specs assert today's inset and hint wording and change with it. Today's Welsh mirrors today's English (repo-frontend-p5-044).

rows.title: Live-animal commodity catalogue matches Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: The live-animal catalogue the commodity search offers grows from five commodities to Design Release 2.1's list, with DR2.1's codes, names and species: 0102 becomes 'Cattle' with 11 species, Horse gains Donkey and Mule, Cat and Dog become 'Domestic cat' and 'Domestic dog', Ferret and Other live mammals join 01061900, Ornamental fish replaces Fish, and the poultry, livestock, rabbit, camel, ostrich, parrot, reptile and bee commodities are added. DR2.1's misspelt horse names and its duplicated 'Other mammal' entry are corrected rather than copied, because the species text reaches the receiving service as the scientific name. The number of packages question follows the new list.
acceptanceCriteria: Searching finds Pig (0103), Sheep (010410), Goat (010420), Chicken (010511), Turkey (010512), Duck (010513), Goose (010514), Guinea fowl (010515), Rabbit (010614), Camel (010613), Ostrich (010633), Parrot (010632), Reptile (010620) and Bees (01064100), each with DR2.1's species. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-112 to -p2-119, -p2-125 to -p2-132; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-033; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-009)

Cattle (0102) offers 11 species: African buffalo (Syncerus spp.), Banteng (Novibos spp), Bison (Bison spp), Bison bison (Bison bison), Buffalo (Bubalus spp (including Anoa)), Cattle (Bos spp), Domestic cattle (Bos taurus), Gaur (Bibos spp.), Musk ox (Ovibos spp), Water buffalo (Bubalus bubalis) and Yak (Poephagus spp.). rows.title: Commodity search results, selected panel and saving the choice follow Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: The server-rendered commodity page changes how it lists and holds a choice: results sorted alphabetically with the matched text in bold, a selected panel that lists each commodity with one chip per species (by Latin name) and a remove button per chip, the 'Select a commodity' error always on the search field, and 'Save and return to overview' that saves the selection as it stands without validating. When the selection leaves only 01061900 species, the unweaned animals answer no longer applies and is cleared.
acceptanceCriteria: Search results list commodities alphabetically by commodity name, and the species under each alphabetically by their label ('common name (Latin name)', or 'commodity name (Latin name)' where a species has no common name). (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-084, prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-109; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-026)

The text that matched the query is shown in bold in the commodity header and the species labels, such as 'Domestic **cattle** (Bos taurus)' for 'cattle'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-024, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-028)

The selected panel lists each chosen commodity as a bold 'Commodity (code):' line followed by one chip per chosen species showing its Latin name, such as 'Cow (0102):' then 'Bos taurus'. rows.title: Commodity search lists results as the trader types, with JavaScript
rows.detail: With JavaScript the commodity search behaves as Design Release 2.1's: results appear as the trader types with no Search press, behind an icon search button; ticking a species keeps the search and leaves the results open for more; Escape closes the results and empties the field while the selection stays; and a polite live region announces how many results there are and how many species are chosen. The real catalogue is too large to ship with the page, so the results are fetched from the service as the trader types. Without JavaScript the page keeps today's server-side Search button, its 3-character minimum and the server-rendered panel.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, typing in the commodity search lists matching results as the trader types, with no Search press, behind an icon search button whose visually hidden text is 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-078; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-008, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-023; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-053, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-008)

Without JavaScript the page keeps the Search button, lists nothing for a query under 3 characters, and renders results and the selected panel on the server. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-008, repo-frontend-p5-080, repo-frontend-p5-082; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p5-008 to -p5-010)

With JavaScript, pressing Escape closes the results and empties the search field, and the selection stays in the panel. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-044; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-057)

With and without JavaScript, the commodity page has no serious or critical axe violations under the wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and wcag22aa tags. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p8-057)

rows.gate: Look at the as-you-type search with and without JavaScript, with a screen reader's announcements, before any other client-side component copies its pattern; check its script is in the built bundle on a fresh stack.
rows.notes: Combines the live-typing slice (req-072), the live-region slice (req-073) and the tick-and-Escape slice (req-074): one client-side component on one page, one review, and none is observable apart from the others. c-012 (ruled): the prototype's as-you-type behaviour wins, but the real constraint that the reference list is too large to ship overrides where the results come from, and the no-JavaScript path stays. Depends on the row 'Commodity search results, selected panel and saving the choice follow Design Release 2.1' in this area, whose sorting, bolding and chips the as-you-type results reuse. A new client-side entry must be wired into the frontend's build, or it fails silently. The tests repo's commodities spec must cover both the JavaScript and the no-JavaScript path.

rows.title: Commodity pages chain as journey steps around the main import reason
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 makes the two commodity pages steps of the journey rather than an overview task that returns to the overview. The commodity page's back link goes to origin and Save and continue goes on to the main import reason; Commodity details comes after the main import reason, its back link goes to the commodity page, and Save and continue goes on to identification, additional or arrival details, whichever applies first.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page's back link goes to the origin of the import page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-018, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-048)

After a valid choice on the commodity page, Save and continue goes to the main import reason page; opened from the overview it returns to the overview instead, and opened from check answers it returns to check answers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-052, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-064; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-066, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-099)

Walking the journey from the start, Commodity details comes after the main import reason page and before identification, additional and arrival details. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-001; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-013, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-014)

rows.gate: Walk the journey from origin to arrival details: this row moves Commodity details after the main import reason, and every row that walks the journey from here on rests on that order.
rows.notes: Combines the back-link slices (req-089, -108) with the next-step slices (req-087, -117, -118): the same journey flow change, observed only together. c-015 (ruled): DR2.1's chaining wins over today's own-overview-task design. c-016: both pages keep the three return controls under DR1's rule (b). c-018: the no-commodity redirect stays. The main import reason page already exists; the reason-and-additional-details area's rows change its copy, not its place. The journey flow is shared with the journey-flow area; the tests repo's journey flow (answerCommodity) walks the new order.

rows.title: Commodity pages return to where the trader came from: check answers, the overview or a template
rows.detail: A trader who opens the commodity pages from check answers, the overview or a template's review should come back there, not walk on through the journey. After a change from check answers, a valid Save and continue on both the commodity page and Commodity details returns to check answers, carried by the real service's change context; from the overview it returns to the overview; while editing a template from its review it returns to the template; and while creating a template a valid Save and continue on the commodity page goes to the overview.
acceptanceCriteria: After choosing Change on a commodity answer from check answers, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page and on Commodity details returns to check answers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-103)
Opened from the overview, a valid Save and continue on Commodity details returns to the overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100)

While editing a template from its review, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page and on Commodity details returns to the template's review. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100)
While a trader is creating a template, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page goes to the notification overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100)
rows.notes: Combines the change-context return (req-119) with the template-creation return (req-091): both are where the commodity pages go back to, on the same two controllers. c-021 (ruled): Commodity details returns to check answers too, carried by ?change=1. Depends on the row 'Commodity pages chain as journey steps around the main import reason' in this area, and on the templates area's rows that let a trader create a template and edit it from its review: the real service has no notification templates today, so the template criteria cannot be observed until those land. The combiner sets both dependencies.

rows.title: A germinal-products notification starts from its category and offers only germinal-product commodities
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 makes germinal products (semen, ova and embryos) a category of the animals notification with its own entry point. A trader starts one from its category, skipping the notification type question and opening at origin, whose back link returns to the germinal products dashboard. The notification records its category, so the commodity search offers only Design Release 2.1's 15 germinal-product commodities with a germinal hint, and a live-animals notification offers only live animals.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a notification with the germinal-products category skips the notification type question and opens at the origin page, whose back link goes to the germinal products dashboard. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-053, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-054, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-055; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-095, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-096)

(trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-057, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-099, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-012)

(prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138 to -p2-155-m1, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-061, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-062; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098)

Every new English string, such as the germinal hint and the germinal commodity names, has its Welsh counterpart, marked as a machine draft. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-044)
rows.gate: Look at a germinal-products notification from its start to the main import reason, and at the category the backend stores, before the germinal Commodity details row and other areas' germinal rows build on it; confirm the default on the open question.
openQuestions: Are germinal products built in this programme? req-003 and c-007 keep Germinal products off the notification type question because no real service takes it, and req-1668 puts the germinal journey's package and weight totals out of scope, yet req-069, -092, -093 and -121 to -127 (and other areas' germinal requirements, such as req-169, -181, -788, -1092) adopt it. Default: build germinal products as a category of the animals notification (a GBN-AG draft in the animals backend), entered only from its category (req-127), never from the type question (req-003). Sam to confirm, or the reconciler to drop these requirements.
rows.notes: Combines the germinal entry slice (req-127) with the germinal catalogue and search slices (req-069, -092, -093): the category must be stored for the search to filter by it, and the catalogue is only observable through a germinal notification. Reference data serves no commodity list (repo-referencedata-p1-089), so the germinal commodities join the frontend's commodity service. The backend has no notification category today and must store it. The germinal products dashboard (req-1092, its 'Create new' carrying category=germinal-products) is the notification-list area's; this row's start accepts the category whether or not that dashboard has landed, and its back link points at it. Depends on the row 'Live-animal commodity catalogue matches Design Release 2.1' in this area, which reshapes the same catalogue. Flagged reconcile contradiction: see the open question; built on its default rather than blocked, because the default stays inside the animals notification and changes no other service.

rows.title: Commodity details asks germinal products for gross weight, packages and storage temperature
rows.detail: Germinal products are counted by weight and packages, not by animals. On Commodity details each germinal species asks 'Total gross weight' in kg and 'Number of packages', both required; a germinal-only consignment also asks one storage 'Temperature'. A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing its species. The gross weight is stored per species and passed on as the consignment's gross weight, the error summary orders errors by question, and the overview's Commodity details task completes only when every germinal answer is valid.
acceptanceCriteria: Each germinal-product species asks 'Total gross weight' in a narrow input with the suffix 'kg'; left blank it shows 'Enter the total gross weight', and anything but a number above 0 with an optional decimal part shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', each linked to that field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-030, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-032, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-031, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-035, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-032, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036)

Each germinal-product species asks 'Number of packages' with no hint and no '(when required)'; left blank it shows 'Enter the number of packages', and anything but a whole number of 1 or more shows 'Enter a whole number greater than 0', each linked to that field; germinal species are not asked the number of animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-024, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-034 to -p3-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-032, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-036; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-033, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-037)

When every chosen species is a germinal product, the page asks one 'Temperature' radio question after all commodity groups, legend at label size, hint 'How will the products be stored', options Ambient, Chilled and Frozen; left unanswered it shows 'Select a temperature', linked to the first option. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-038 to -p3-041; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-033, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-034)

When any chosen species is a live animal, the Temperature question is not asked, and a temperature saved earlier is cleared. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-044, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-078; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-033-m1, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-033-m2)

A germinal-product commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, such as '05111000 | Cattle, Semen | Bos taurus', its block is headed '<name> (<code>)', such as 'Cattle, Semen (05111000)', and its species sections are separated by section breaks. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-011, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-020; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-031)

The error summary lists errors by question, every species for one question before the next: number of animals, then total gross weight, then number of packages, then temperature. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-038; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-035)

Saved germinal weights, packages and temperature are filled in when Commodity details is reopened, and the GBN-AG notification the backend publishes carries each germinal species' total gross weight as that line's gross weight. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-030, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-083; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-143; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010 (c-022))

The overview's Commodity details task shows Complete only when every chosen species has valid answers (live animals: number of animals; germinal products: gross weight and number of packages) and, for a germinal-only consignment, a valid temperature; with no species chosen it is not Complete. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054)
Every new English string on the page has its Welsh counterpart, marked as a machine draft. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-044)
openQuestions: Are germinal products built in this programme? (the same contradiction as the germinal entry row: req-003, c-007 and req-1668 against the adopted germinal requirements). Default: build them as a category of the animals notification; Sam to confirm.
rows.notes: Combines the weight (req-121, -122), packages (req-123), temperature (req-124) and table (req-125) slices with the error-order (req-114) and task-status (req-126) slices: one page's germinal branch, one backend change to store weight and temperature, one review. c-022 (ruled): the answer is a gross weight, stored and passed on as gross weight, not the prototype's netWeight key. The backend stores per-species packages today but no weight or temperature. req-114's live-animal half (every animal count before every package count) is observable without germinal products and changes here too. Reading germinal answers back on check answers is the review area's (req-842). Depends on the row 'A germinal-products notification starts from its category and offers only germinal-product commodities' in this area.
